data.title: Insurer requests documents for water damage claim
data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG (household contents claims) asks Mara Beispiel to send a list of damaged items with purchase receipts and photos for her water damage claim of 19 March 2026. The documents are due within 10 working days of the letter date, 27 March 2026.
data.explanation: Your insurer needs more information before it can process your water damage claim. Please send a list of the damaged items (Aufstellung) with proof of purchase (Kaufbelege) and photos of the damage. The deadline is 10 working days (Werktage, Monday to Saturday excluding public holidays) from the date of the letter; the app shows the exact date. If you don't send the documents in time, the insurer will decide the claim based on the file as it stands (nach Aktenlage), which may be less favourable. If you need more time, contact the insurer quickly.

items.title: Send claim documents
